name: Deliberative Poll on Healthcare and Financial Ethics in Italy
content: Problems and Purpose Background History and Context Organizing, Supporting, and Funding Entities Participant Recruitment and Selection Methods and Tools Used This initiative used the Deliberative Polling® method which involves various tools of engagement including surveys (before and after), information and question and answer periods with experts , small group deliberation (such as thematic dialogue tables or future workshops ) and plenary discussion.
